article.title: который en acusativo: formas y excepción de animacidad
article.chapter: Acusativo y animacidad — Винительный падеж и одушевлённость

claims.summary: ReadyRussian states that который is declined like an adjective, uses antecedent gender/number, and takes the case of the item replaced in the relative clause.
The listed accusative forms and the человека/которого example match the directly inspected table and instructions; Kholodilova documents the restricted animate-accusative mismatch.

Я ищу человека, которого я сфотографировал вчера is the exact example in ReadyRussian; the academic study’s exceptional contexts are accurately bounded to collective masculine or neuter animate-referent antecedents.
The entry distinguishes the general table from the specific animacy-mismatch contexts described in the academic article, avoiding an exception-free rule.
